speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Will you please turn your shirt off?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: What? I'm giving myself dramatic entrance music. People will know I'm awesome and to be feared.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Yeah, right, there's nothing more awesome and frightening than a man who's got music blasting from between his nipples.

speaker: stuart_bloom
text: Well, you might want to mark your Google calendars. Stan Lee is coming to do a signing on Thursday.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Did he finally write a sequel to his autobiography? I'm sure ages 79 through 87 were just action-packed.

speaker: stuart_bloom
text: No, just a regular comic signing. My uncle is his dermatologist and Stan's doing him a favour.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, I don't want to know that! How can I possibly discuss with Stan Lee the scientific foundations for interstellar flight on a silver surfboard when part of my brain will be scanning his face for signs of contagious skin disease?

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Stan Lee does not have a contagious skin disease.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, look who thinks he's Stuart's uncle now.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Can't believe it. We're going to meet Stan Lee!
